hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that routes swaps entirely through Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes trade amounts using an internal bonding curve, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass standard pool math. Standard liquidity provisioning and donations are blocked.
